outcome: Low-positioned placenta in the third trimester
cohort: 958 women undergoing a transvaginal ultrasound examination between 18 and 24 weeks' gestation who had a low-positioned placenta, defined as an IOD of < 20 mm.
finding: The cut-off value of IOD in the second trimester to identify all cases of an abnormally located placenta in the third trimester was 15.5 mm for posteriorly located placentae, while for anteriorly located placentae the IOD cut-off was lower, namely -4.5 mm, representing a 4.5-mm overlap of the placental edge over the internal os of the cervix.
